title: Dold-2025-dareplane-10.1088/1741-2552/adbb20
description: Intracranial recordings from one Parkinson's disease patient with externalised bilateral subthalamic DBS leads and an epidural ECoG strip over left primary motor cortex. Data were recorded on days 2-4 after implantation while the patient performed the CopyDraw task with DBS off, with open-loop DBS on, and with closed-loop adaptive DBS run on the Dareplane platform. The dataset accompanies the Dareplane proof-of-concept paper and includes LFP, ECoG and EOG channels, with event markers from port and stimulation channels.
methods_description: Neuro Omega recordings at 22 kHz with 24 channels (16 STN LFP contacts, 4 epidural ECoG contacts, 4 EOG channels) were acquired during the CopyDraw task under stimulation-off, open-loop stimulation and closed-loop stimulation conditions. ECoG was referenced to the left earlobe and DBS recordings to the left mastoid. Raw int16 counts were converted to BIDS-iEEG BrainVision format, with port and stimulation markers as events.
